subject.title: fix(web-fetch): forward NO_PROXY to EnvHttpProxyAgent options so env proxy respects bypass entries

question: Should this branch be repurposed as narrow EnvHttpProxyAgent option hardening, or should it pause behind the canonical NO_PROXY/SSRF policy decision for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93807?
rationale: The code change is not the complete web_fetch fix, and the complete behavior changes how operator NO_PROXY bypasses interact with SSRF protection.

options.title: Pause for canonical policy
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until maintainers choose the guarded-fetch NO_PROXY behavior and decide whether this option-forwarding change remains useful.

options.title: Narrow And Prove Hardening
options.body: Remove the closing claim, add option-forwarding tests, and require real proxy proof before considering it as a small hardening PR.

options.title: Close for replacement
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the fix must live only in the guarded-fetch policy path or a newer canonical PR.

recommendation.title: Pause for canonical policy
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until maintainers choose the guarded-fetch NO_PROXY behavior and decide whether this option-forwarding change remains useful.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest history on the trusted env-proxy web_fetch opt-in and the proxy-env/guarded-fetch boundary.
